items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: Tommy Saunders is mentioned only by the Interviewer; the Interviewee does not mention Tommy Saunders or indicate any personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah. In fact I happened to be listening to that band this morning but on the old McKinney Cotton Pickers, not the new ones. And does Wilburn play an instrument now? No. Wilburn sings. He was a banjo player. Was he? Yeah.

They have two units. They're using a small unit and a large unit. Tommy Saunders is playing trumpet with him sometimes. And Tommy's a wonderful player. And there's some awfully good musicians in the Detroit area too, so I imagine that they can put together some very fine bands. Yeah.
The Gabriel Brothers and their father are up there. Different ones, different New Orleans musicians are up around there too.
